sender.sl: Znanec iz imenika (čigar račun je že prevzet)
sender.en: A contact in your phone (whose account is already taken over)

name.sl: Lažno glasovanje na WhatsAppu: koda poveže napravo goljufov
name.en: Fake vote on WhatsApp: a code links the scammers’ device

how.sl: Prek WhatsAppa, pogosto od znanca, prejmete prošnjo, naj glasujete na tekmovanju ali za projekt. Stran z glasovanjem zahteva vašo telefonsko številko, nato pa morate v WhatsApp vpisati prikazano osemmestno kodo ali skenirati kodo QR. S tem ne glasujete, ampak potrdite povezavo naprave goljufov z vašim računom. Ti nato berejo vaše pogovore in v vašem imenu pošiljajo enake povezave ali prošnje za denar vašim stikom.
how.en: On WhatsApp, often from someone you know, you are asked to vote in a contest or for a project. The voting page asks for your phone number, then you must type a displayed eight-digit code into WhatsApp or scan a QR code. You don’t vote: you confirm a link between the scammers’ device and your account. They then read your chats and send the same links, or requests for money, to your contacts in your name.

text.sl: Znanec prosi za glas prek povezave.
text.en: A contact asks for your vote through a link.

text.sl: Stran zahteva telefonsko številko in kodo ali sken kode QR.
text.en: The page asks for your phone number and a code or a QR scan.

text.sl: Goljufi prevzamejo račun in pišejo vašim stikom.
text.en: The scammers take over the account and message your contacts.

text.sl: Živjo! Moja nečakinja je v finalu tekmovanja mladih plesalcev, pa ji manjka še nekaj glasov 🙏 Bi lahko glasoval/a zanjo? Traja 10 sekund: [povezava] Hvala tiiisoč!
text.en: Hi! My niece is in the final of a young dancers’ contest and she’s a few votes short 🙏 Could you vote for her? It takes 10 seconds: [link] Thanks a milliooon!

en: whatsapp vote link asked for a code
friend asked me to vote in a contest
typed an eight digit code into whatsapp
scanned a qr code to vote
my whatsapp was taken over linked devices

sl: Za glasovanje nikoli ne potrebujete kode iz WhatsAppa ali skeniranja kode QR.
Prošnja za glas lahko pride tudi od znanca, katerega račun je že prevzet.
Koda za povezavo naprave odpre vaš račun drugim.
en: A vote never needs a WhatsApp code or a QR scan.
The request can come from a friend whose account is already taken over.
A device-linking code opens your account to others.

sl: Ne vpisujte kode. V WhatsAppu odprite Povezane naprave in odstranite neznane naprave.
Vklopite preverjanje v dveh korakih s PIN-om.
Opozorite stike in znanca, od katerega je prišlo sporočilo.
en: Don’t enter the code. In WhatsApp open Linked devices and remove any you don’t recognise.
Turn on two-step verification with a PIN.
Warn your contacts and the friend the message came from.

sources.title: Če ste prek WhatsAppa dobili takšno sporočilo, bodite pazljivi
